policies.title: Release rules
policies.subtitle: Release rules: conditions a new version must meet before it ships.
policies.empty: No release rules yet. Start from the default rules, then adjust them.
policies.loadError: Could not load the release rules
policies.pick: Pick a rule set on the left, or create a new one.
policies.fileNameHint: Lower case letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.', ending in .yaml
policies.name: Name
policies.onUnknown: When there is not enough data to check a rule

policies.minN: Minimum runs before the rule applies
policies.deleteConfirm: Delete {{file}}? Comparisons that use these rules will stop working until you pick other rules.
